title: The Ancestry of Stories — Version 0
scope: Prototype knowledge graph of literary and creative influence with cultural, biographical, historical, and cross-media context.
method_note: Edges distinguish explicit influence from scholarship, lineage, context, inference, and comparison. A connection is not automatically a claim of direct borrowing.
limitations: Curated seed corpus, not a representative sample of world literature.
Network metrics describe this prototype only and must not be interpreted as universal rankings.
Edges marked review require stronger or more specific sourcing before publication as authoritative claims.
Approximate dates are used for traditions and composite ancient works.
